.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (report rules, known false positives incl. likert vs weighted)
evidence: Structure is graded, not all-or-nothing. scoring.toml (identical to the frozen template; score.py identical too) has two 0.0-mass binary gates (render, constraints; all_pass), then weighted_mean of functional 0.6 / polish 0.2 / visual 0.2 with functional floor 0.05 (score.py:40-48). Functional has 16 independent binary criteria with weights 1.0-4.0 summing to 42 (functional/judge.toml:32-35 comment re-derived: 3+4+4+2+1.5+4+4+2+3+1.5+1.5+1.5+2.5+1.5+4+2=42); polish has 6 binary x1.0; visual has 4 likert 0-5 with anchors at every level. Granularity of functional is 1.5/42 (~0.036). Worked spread by reasoning: blank page/static mock/seed copy fail render or constraints (post+reload+second-context readback) -> 0. A working persistent chat with no walls/timers/holds plausibly passes signin_and_client_scope 3, nested_replies 1.5, safe_formatting 1.5, message_links 1.5, unread 1.5, live_updates 1.5, sent_once_in_order 2.5, persistence 2 (explicitly durability-only, line 278), edits 3 => ~18/42 = 0.43 functional, i.e. reward ~0.26 + polish/visual share; adding walls (wall_every_route 4, mentions/links 4, wall_added_live 2) and retention (deleted/expired 4, timer 4, holds 2, search/transcript 4) climbs toward 1.0. So partial apps land mid-range and ranks follow the brief's two stated priorities (walls, retention carry the 4.0 weights). No single precondition beyond sign-in (which the gates already establish) controls all criteria. Shared dependency noted, not a defect: a working transcript page is a positive control or sub-check in 8 functional criteria (signin_and_client_scope, wall_every_route, deleted_and_expired, timer_changes, edits, safe_formatting, sent_once_in_order, search_and_transcript) = 26/42 mass, plus polish transcript_print and visual transcript_page. An app missing only the transcript caps at ~16/42 functional. This is backed by public requirements (instruction.md:5,9; walls-and-retention.md:17,35; conversations.md:13,31 name transcripts as a route walls/formatting/ordering must cover), so it is legitimate coverage, but it concentrates signal. Floor cliff: an app passing only one 1.5-weight criterion (0.036 <= 0.05) gets 0 regardless of polish/visual - intended template behaviour. Attempted counterexamples: (a) broken app scoring high - gates require real shared persistence and every functional negative has a positive control, so a refuse-everything app cannot farm credit; (b) conforming app collapsing to 0 - none found, criteria use app controls and any clear format. Risk=true because raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'reward discrimination/ranking on these bytes and Oracle/target scores for these bytes are absent': no configured judge run on weak/partial apps measured the spread, and the scripted golden only covers the reference. The spread above is reasoned, not measured.
